theme: An open day before tomorrow's Brunswick call.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — a clear runway. The best use of it is arriving at tomorrow's 11 AM Brunswick call ready, and clearing the couple of overdue bookings before their windows close.

needsAttention.title: Get ready for the Brunswick call
needsAttention.detail: Erika Maass, who leads senior recruitment at Brunswick, has you at 11 AM ET tomorrow on Teams. Arrive with your two-firm story tight and a couple of sharp questions about the role.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Two weeks overdue on the board. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — book it refundable now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Send ICGN the bio and post the announcement
needsAttention.detail: Drew sent detailed edits yesterday: lead with the two Big Four roles and drop the 'seeking' language. ICGN needs the bio for the Toronto panel, and the LinkedIn post can go out alongside it.

flagged.title: Shawn Maher named his EY successor
flagged.detail: He replied with Didem Nisanci's name and background and left the door open — worth a short reply to keep the thread warm.

flagged.title: Nautilus BVI sail-and-scuba cabin
flagged.detail: Fede at Nautilus offered you and Mike one cabin for two on a BVI trip — no rush, but a fun one to weigh.

resolved.title: Said yes to Maine Visionaries

resolved.title: Brunswick call locked for Wednesday
resolved.detail: You and Erika settled on 11 AM ET tomorrow and you confirmed — nothing left but to show up ready.
